wire.headline: Energy Firm Reports Profit Decline and Job Cuts Amidst Regulatory Scrutiny
sentences: The company reported a 7% year-on-year rise in revenue to 4.26bn GBP for the quarter ending 30 September.
Pre-tax profit fell by 12% to 310m GBP during the same period.
The firm announced it will cut 850 jobs, representing about 6% of its total workforce.
Two gas plants, located in Wales and Kent, are scheduled to close by March 2027.
CEO Marian Holt stated that cost pressure has been sharper than expected.
Ofgem has opened an investigation into the company's billing system.
The dividend remains unchanged at 12.4p a share.
Shares dropped by 4.2% in morning trading.
